name: Light Bridge
description: Connect matching orbs with bridges that never cross. Boards grow from 4 by 4 to 9 by 9.

about.concept: Spatial planning under constraints. Matching orbs must be joined by bridges that never cross, so the child plans routes, looks ahead, and revises when two paths collide.
about.progression: Boards grow from 4 by 4 with two pairs to 9 by 9 with many, and later boards need a route to be found that leaves room for every other route.
